Tax Audit

The Tax Audit report helps you verify that your tax calculations are accurate and compliant with tax regulations.

This report analyzes all transactions containing tax codes and shows detailed breakdowns of tax amounts, helping you identify any discrepancies or issues.

Use this report to prepare for tax audits, verify tax collection accuracy, and ensure proper tax reporting across all your transactions.

Description

Add an optional description or note that will appear on the report.

From

The starting date for the tax audit period.

To

The ending date for the tax audit period.

Accounting method

Select whether to use accrual or cash basis accounting for this report.
